claims.claim_text: Reinforcement learning (RL) was trained using a significantly larger amount of data: 12 days of driving, compared to 14 hours used by imitation learning.
claims.normalized_text: RL training data duration is 12 days, imitation learning training data duration is 14 hours.

claims.claim_text: Reinforcement learning underperforms compared to imitation learning despite strong results on tasks such as Atari games and maze navigation.
claims.normalized_text: RL underperforms compared to imitation learning despite strong results on Atari games and maze navigation.

claims.claim_text: Reinforcement learning is known to be brittle and commonly requires extensive task-specific hyperparameter search, such as 50 trials per environment as reported by Mnih et al.
claims.normalized_text: RL is brittle and requires extensive task-specific hyperparameter search, e.g., 50 trials per environment.
